base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.

fields.name: SPIE
fields.description: SPI Interrupt Enable Bit (1=enabled; 0=disabled).

fields.name: SPE
fields.description: SPI System Enable Bit (1=enabled; 0=disabled, low power).

fields.name: SPTIE
fields.description: SPI Transmit Interrupt Enable (1=SPTEF interrupt enabled).

fields.name: MSTR
fields.description: SPI Master/Slave Mode Select (1=Master, 0=Slave).

fields.name: CPOL
fields.description: Clock Polarity (1=Active-low; SCK idle HIGH. 0=Active-high; SCK idle LOW).

fields.name: CPHA
fields.description: Clock Phase (1=sample on even edges 2,4,...,16; 0=sample on odd edges 1,3,...,15).

fields.name: SSOE
fields.description: Slave Select Output Enable; only effective in master mode with MODFEN=1.

fields.name: LSBFE
fields.description: LSB-First Enable (1=LSB first; 0=MSB first).

registers.name: SPICR2
registers.access: Read / Write (anytime; reserved bits writes ignored)

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads return 0; writes have no effect.

fields.name: MODFEN
fields.description: Mode Fault Enable (1=SS port pin with MODF feature; 0=SS not used by SPI).

fields.name: BIDIROE
fields.description: Output buffer enable in bidirectional mode (with SPC0=1).

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads return 0; writes have no effect.

fields.name: SPISWAI
fields.description: SPI Stop in Wait Mode (1=stop SPI clock in wait; 0=normal in wait).

fields.name: SPC0
fields.description: Serial Pin Control Bit 0 (1=bidirectional mode; 0=normal mode).

registers.name: SPIBR
registers.access: Read / Write (anytime; reserved bits writes ignored)

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads return 0.

fields.name: SPPR2-SPPR0
fields.description: SPI Baud Rate Preselection (preselect divisor stage).

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads return 0.

fields.name: SPR2-SPR0
fields.description: SPI Baud Rate Selection (selection divisor stage).

fields.name: SPIF
fields.description: SPI Interrupt Flag (1=new data copied to SPIDR).

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads 0.

fields.name: SPTEF
fields.description: SPI Transmit Empty Interrupt Flag (1=SPI data register empty).

fields.name: MODF
fields.description: Mode Fault Flag (1=Mode fault has occurred).

fields.name: Reserved
fields.description: Reads 0.

registers.name: Reserved_$4
registers.access: Writes ignored; reads return all zeros.

registers.name: SPIDR
registers.access: Read (normally only when SPIF set) / Write (anytime)

fields.name: Bit7..Bit0
fields.description: Data byte; write to queue TX; read to dequeue RX.

registers.name: Reserved_$6
registers.access: Writes ignored; reads return all zeros.

registers.name: Reserved_$7
registers.access: Writes ignored; reads return all zeros.

notes: Module memory map per Table 3-1. Reads from reserved bits return zeros and writes to reserved bits have no effect.
